name: cavemio-usage-meter
title: Usage meter
description: Credits, messages or context left: quiet when there’s plenty, clear before it runs out.

cavemio.accessibility:
- role="meter" with aria-valuetext like "1,240 of 2,000 credits left", so the number is read, not a percentage.
- Colour is never the only signal: the text changes too, and the ring has a title with the full summary.
- Numbers are mono and tabular, so they don’t jitter as they roll. The rolling text is decorative; the meter’s aria-valuetext carries the real figures.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the bar, ring and numbers change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: used / limit
props.description: – · How much is used, out of how much.

props.name: unit / label
props.description: "credits" / "Usage" · What’s counted, and the meter’s name.

props.name: resetAt
props.description: – · When it resets; shown under the bar and in the out state.

props.name: variant
props.description: "bar" · A full-width bar, or a 16px ring with a percentage.

props.name: lowAt
props.description: 0.2 · Share left at which it turns amber.

useCases.title: AI apps with credits
useCases.description: Show credits or messages left and when they reset.

useCases.title: Settings and billing menus
useCases.description: A bar in the account menu that shows how much is used.

useCases.title: Composer toolbars
useCases.description: A small ring for how full the context window is.

useCases.title: API products
useCases.description: A quota meter that nudges people toward upgrading before they hit it.

features.title: Quiet when there is plenty
features.description: The numbers roll as credits are spent and the bar eases, with nothing shouting.

features.title: Amber before it runs out
features.description: Once a fifth is left (you can change that) the bar turns amber and an Upgrade link opens in.

features.title: Clear when it is out
features.description: The numbers fold away, the words become “No credits left”, and the footer reads “You’re out until Oct 12.”

features.title: A bar or a ring
features.description: Use the bar in settings and menus, or a small ring that fits a composer toolbar.

features.title: Read as words
features.description: The meter reports “1,240 of 2,000 credits left” to screen readers, not just a percentage.

features.title: Any unit
features.description: Count credits, messages, tokens or anything else, and name the meter.

states.title: normal
states.description: "1,240 of 2,000 credits left" over a neutral bar, and when it resets. Spending rolls the numbers (700ms) and eases the bar.

states.title: low
states.description: The bar turns amber once a fifth (lowAt) is left and the Upgrade link opens in beside the reset date.

states.title: out
states.description: Red. The numbers fold away while "credits left" morphs into "No credits left"; the footer morphs to "You’re out until Oct 12."

states.title: ring
states.description: A ring that fills and a percent that rolls; amber when low, red when full.
